prereg.split: Phase B caches only (swechat_B, cc_local_B, aiv_cc_B, aiv_cu_B); A split not read.

context_measure.anthropic_style: usage_in + usage_cache_read + usage_cache_create (claude_code formats, opencode, aiv_cu anthropic)
context_measure.includes_cache_style: usage_in (codex: last_token_usage.input_tokens; gemini CLI / aiv_cu gemini: promptTokenCount)
context_measure.check: cache_read <= usage_in is counted for includes_cache formats; opencode is checked by both readings

prereg.zero_context: API calls with C == 0 are dropped from pairs (counted).

break_flags.compaction: window holds a compaction marker: CC system compact_boundary; codex compacted / context_compacted; opencode part compaction; or a system text starting 'This session is being continued'
break_flags.microcompact: window holds a CC system microcompact_boundary
break_flags.image: >=1 image marker ('[image]' or '[IMAGE_REMOVED]') in window text or call-k text (aiv_cu: not used, see aiv_cu)
break_flags.user_turn: window holds a kind=user event (human prompt): thinking-retention rules change at human turns
break_flags.model_switch: model of call k != model of call k+1
break_flags.api_error: window holds a CC system api_error meta event
break_flags.foreign_generated: window holds an assistant/call event not assigned to call k (unaligned stream)
break_flags.member_switch: cc_local: extra.family_member differs between call k and call k+1 (resumed file of a family)
break_flags.attachment_unavailable: cc_local/swechat CC: a visible attachment whose text was not recorded (text_source unavailable)

models.M_chars: dC ~ result_chars + system_chars + user_chars + assistant_chars + args_chars + thinking_chars + n_calls + n_results + n_system + intercept (OLS, clean pairs)
models.M_out: dC - out_k ~ result_chars + system_chars + user_chars + n_calls + n_results + n_system + intercept (OLS, clean pairs): uses the provider's output-token count for call k instead of its chars
models.aiv_cu_gemini_text: dTEXT ~ same terms as M_chars on promptTokensDetails.TEXT; dIMAGE analysed separately
models.cross_fit: 2 folds by md5(session_id) parity; every residual is out-of-fold (fit on the other fold)

detector.D_abs: flag a pair when |residual| > T, T = 0.99 quantile of |out-of-fold residual| over clean pairs of the OTHER fold
detector.D_bin: same, T per bin of logged window non-generated chars, bins [0,1e2,1e3,1e4,1e5,inf) (logged = tampered value)
detector.tamper: replace the LARGEST result in the window by text whose length differs by delta chars (delta>0 longer, delta<0 shorter, delta >= -len(result)); predicted dC shifts by beta_result * delta; actual dC unchanged
detector.delta_grid: log-spaced 10**(i/20) for i=0..120 (1 .. 1e6 chars), both signs
detector.assumption: substituted text tokenizes at the fitted chars/token of results (beta_result)

M_hyb_primary.rule: primary model M_hyb: dC ~ res_chars + res_nl + res_nonascii_bytes + n_results + res_stderr_chars(aiv_cu only) + sys_chars + n_system + F*out_k + F*reasoning_tokens_k + F + (1-F)*(assistant_chars, args_chars, thinking_chars, n_calls) + intercept, F = out_final = (out_k > 0 and generated chars <= 6 * out_k)
M_hyb_primary.why_added: in-sample exploratory fits of the pre-registered M_chars / M_out showed (a) the logged output_tokens of Claude Code calls is a streaming partial (<= 10) in 29% of swechat CC, 19% of cc_local and 89% of aiv_cc clean pairs, so M_out fails there; (b) cc_local thinking blocks are logged with 0 chars in 66% of clean pairs, so M_chars fails there. M_hyb uses the token count when it is plausible from the call's own logged chars, else chars. F uses only call k's own log fields, never dC. M_chars and M_out are still reported (cross-fitted).

huber.rule: all fits are Huber IRLS (c = 1.345 x 1.4826 x MAD of residuals, <= 50 iterations) instead of OLS
huber.why_added: exploratory OLS coefficients were pulled by heavy tails (e.g. n_calls vs n_results +-3000 tokens, collinear); residual quantiles are reported for every pair, so robust fitting only changes the centre

collinear_counts.rule: n_results enters every model; n_calls only in the chars regime (1-F)
collinear_counts.why_added: n_calls == n_results in almost every clean pair (exploratory coefficients +-3000)

res_shape_terms.rule: res_nl (newline count) and res_nonascii (utf-8 bytes - chars) of window results added to M_hyb
res_shape_terms.why_added: Read results are line-numbered and some outputs are non-ASCII; both change chars/token. Both are computed from the logged text only

codex_large_result.rule: break flag (excluded from clean): swechat:codex window whose largest result > 40,000 chars
codex_large_result.why_added: exploratory binned table showed dC - out_k saturating near 11.6k tokens for single results above ~60k chars (the model sees a truncated output; the log keeps it all). Reported in codex_saturation

tool_aware.rule: detection_M_hyb_by_tool: pairs whose window results all come from one tool (>= 1000 clean pairs); thresholds computed within that tool's pairs (other fold), pooled-model residuals
tool_aware.why_added: per-tool |residual| p99 differed several-fold (e.g. edit vs read windows)

asym_detector.rule: D_asym: flag when the residual is below the 0.005 or above the 0.995 quantile of signed out-of-fold residuals of the other fold (two one-sided 0.5% tails)
asym_detector.why_added: honest residuals are skewed (positive tail longer: the model saw more than the log); a symmetric |r| threshold wastes power on the short side

model_aware.rule: detection_M_hyb_model_aware: residuals and rates from an M_hyb cross-fit within each model_k1 with >= 500 clean pairs (pooled-model residual otherwise); same detector rules
model_aware.why_added: per-model residual medians differed by several hundred tokens in aiv_cu (thinking retention differs by model), which a pooled fit cannot absorb

tamper_rate.rule: the predicted-dC shift of a tamper of delta chars uses the pair's effective rate beta_res + beta_nl * (res_nl/res_chars) + beta_nonascii * (res_nonascii/res_chars) (replacement text has the window's composition); beta_res alone when res_chars == 0

user_turn_eval.rule: pairs with a human user event are scored with the clean model plus beta_res * user_chars (user text at the result-text rate, no framing term; no user term can be fitted on clean pairs)
user_turn_eval.why_added: clean pairs exclude user turns by definition; the fitted sys term is unstable in formats with few system events (first test run: opencode beta_sys = -2360 tokens/char)

min_nonzero_terms.rule: a design column with fewer than 30 non-zero pairs in the fitting set is dropped (coef 0)
min_nonzero_terms.why_added: first test run: opencode sys_chars fitted from a handful of pairs gave -2360 tokens/char

thinking_chars.rule: think = max(thinking chars of call k's thinking-only meta rows, thinking chars on its assistant/call events) + aiv_cu reasoning_chars
thinking_chars.why_added: CC thinking chars appear on both the thinking-only meta row and the next block event; the event-side count can carry over between calls

single_result_dominated.rule: F==1, exactly 1 result, no system text, result >= 2000 chars; chars / (dC - out_k)
F==1, exactly 1 result, no system text, result >= 2000 chars; chars / (dC - out_k)

write.skipped: fewer than 100 out-of-fold residuals in a fold

edit.skipped: fewer than 100 out-of-fold residuals in a fold

codex_saturation.rule: swechat:codex pairs with exactly one result, no system/user text, no compaction, F==1; y = dC - out_k
